evidence: Matches the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies HTTP RPC authentication handling in src/httprpc.cpp.
rationale: Fixes a denial-of-service vector where clients can tie up all HTTP RPC worker threads by submitting invalid credentials. Category guidance explicitly emphasizes 'resource exhaustion through the HTTP server', and removing the 250 ms UninterruptibleSleep closes an easy worker-exhaustion vulnerability without reintroducing timing attack risks.
